---
name: db-migration
description: Create and apply an Alembic migration for schema changes (new tables/columns, pgvector indexes). Use for any change to SQLAlchemy models under backend/app/modules/.
---

# Database migrations

Alembic is configured async and reads `Settings.DATABASE_URL` (`backend/alembic/env.py`). The docker postgres must be up (`docker compose up -d postgres`).

## Workflow

```bash
cd backend
# 1. Edit the SQLAlchemy models (app/modules/*/models.py) first
uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m "short_description"
# 2. REVIEW the generated file in alembic/versions/ — autogenerate misses things (see below)
uv run alembic upgrade head
uv run alembic current          # confirm at head
uv run pytest -q                # tests build chatbot_test from Base.metadata, so they catch model/migration drift
```

## What autogenerate gets wrong here

- **pgvector**: `Vector(N)` columns need `import pgvector.sqlalchemy` in the migration file; the `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector` only exists in the initial migration — new databases replay the chain so keep it there.
- **Vector indexes**: HNSW/IVFFlat indexes are NOT autogenerated. Add manually, mirroring the initial migration `542eb8b7605b`:
  ```python
  op.create_index("ix_<table>_embedding_hnsw", "<table>", ["embedding"],
                  postgresql_using="hnsw", postgresql_ops={"embedding": "vector_cosine_ops"})
  ```
- **Enums-as-strings**: statuses are plain `String` columns by design (e.g. `documents.status`) — don't let autogenerate "fix" them into PG enums.
- Changing `EMBEDDING_DIM` (768) means a new `Vector(dim)` column type + index rebuild + re-embedding all chunks — that's a data migration, plan it explicitly, don't just alter the setting.

## Rules

- Never edit an already-applied migration; add a new one.
- Every migration needs a working `downgrade()`.
- Test DB (`chatbot_test`) is rebuilt from `Base.metadata` per test — if tests pass but `alembic upgrade head` fails (or vice versa), models and migrations have drifted; fix the migration chain.
